correctness.rationale: Condition on side occupancy (probabilities p_i). Affine invariance implies the 2+1 and 1+1+1 conditional probabilities depend on occupancy alone. In barycentric unit triangle, 2+1 capture is integral_(1/2)^1 2r(2r-1)/(3r-1)^2 dr =1/9+4log2/27. For one point on each side, the three half-plane failure events are disjoint and each has volume 1/3-2log2/9; capture b=2log2/3. Thus P=3a(e2-3e3)+6b e3. Both polynomial coefficients are positive and e2,e3 strictly Schur-concave on the allowed p_i<1/2. e2>1/4 with e3>0 and equilateral equality prove sharp bounds. Independent 220000 draws on four triangle shapes matched within 1.76 binomial standard errors; quadrature checks support conditionals but do not replace proof.
